title: Computer Vision and Knowledge-Grounded Language Models for Intelligent Beekeeper Assistance
abstract: arXiv:2610.29283v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Managed and wild bees sustain roughly a third of the global food products, yet colonies face mounting stress from climate-change including extreme weather patterns, altered parasite and disease patterns. Timely assessment of colony condition such as understanding colony strength, brood area, honey and pollen storage, comb usage, is essential to adaptive management. However, manual hive frame inspection is slow, costly, and quality depends on scarce expertise. We present an artificial targeted intelligent system framework focusing on edge deployable pipeline that turns hive frame photographs into interpretable and action-oriented inspection report. The pipeline includes an object detector to detect biologically-meaningful comb-cell classes; detections are distilled into structured fact schema; facts are converted into constrained factual text; the text triggers a grounded knowledge-base for interpretations and recommendations. translated_title: 基于计算机视觉与知识增强语言模型的智能养蜂辅助系统
translated_abstract: 人工饲养和野生蜜蜂维持着全球约三分之一的食品生产，然而蜂群正面临气候变化带来的日益加剧的压力，包括极端天气模式以及寄生虫和疾病模式的改变。及时评估蜂群状况——例如了解蜂群强度、育虫面积、蜂蜜和花粉储存以及巢脾使用情况——对于适应性管理至关重要。然而，人工检查巢框速度慢、成本高，且检查质量依赖于稀缺的专业知识。我们提出了一个聚焦于边缘可部署流水线的人工智能系统框架，可将蜂巢巢框照片转化为可解释、面向行动的检查报告。该流水线包括一个目标检测器，用于检测具有生物学意义的巢房类别；检测结果被提炼为结构化事实模式；事实被转换为受约束的事实性文本；文本随后触发一个基于知识库的接地系统，用于生成解释和建议。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种边缘可部署的智能系统框架，结合计算机视觉目标检测与知识增强语言模型，将蜂巢巢框照片自动转化为可解释、面向行动的蜂群检查报告，从而辅助养蜂人高效评估蜂群状况。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an edge-deployable AI framework that combines computer vision-based object detection with knowledge-grounded language models to automatically transform hive frame photographs into interpretable, action-oriented inspection reports, assisting beekeepers in efficiently assessing colony conditions.
